steps.name: preflight
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --prune origin; test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = "f6f316308520cff744b8a02545a5dedb09b27dbc"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; cd interface; npm ci --ignore-scripts >/dev/null

steps.name: minimal-security-update
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm uninstall --save-dev --ignore-scripts size-limit @size-limit/preset-app; npm uninstall --ignore-scripts glob; npm install --save-dev --ignore-scripts 'glob@^13.0.6'; npm install --save-exact --ignore-scripts svelte@5.57.0; npm install --save-dev --save-exact --ignore-scripts @inlang/paraglide-js@2.25.0 @sveltejs/kit@2.70.3 vite@7.3.6; npm install --save-dev --ignore-scripts vitest@4.1.11 @vitest/ui@4.1.11 @vitest/coverage-v8@4.1.11 dependency-cruiser@17.4.3 rollup@4.63.1; npm install --save-dev --ignore-scripts knip@5.82.1 prettier@3.8.1; npm pkg set 'overrides.cookie=0.7.2'; npm install --ignore-scripts; npm ci --ignore-scripts; cd ..; git diff --check; git diff --stat

steps.name: audit-and-size
package-versions
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm ls --depth=0 @inlang/paraglide-js @sveltejs/kit svelte vite vitest @vitest/ui @vitest/coverage-v8 dependency-cruiser rollup tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite daisyui knip prettier glob || true
